metadata.description: Personal Claude Code marketplace: one /task workflow (create, start and end, with sub-sessions per item) plus stack check plugins (frontend, server incl. Supabase).

plugins.name: workflow
plugins.description: Backlog-driven work loop as one skill: /task create, /task start, /task end. Claude invokes it on its own when you ask to add, start or finish a backlog item. create and start open a sub-session by default (start in its own worktree on a w/ branch); the starting session relays its questions and approvals, leaves plan approval to the sub-session's plan mode, and reports when it finishes; end runs in that work session. create --survey reads raw sources against a goal and proposes item candidates. --here, or no session tool, runs it in the current session. Scales planning to task size and settles the tools and steps the best practitioners use, checks acceptance criteria only with outside evidence or a separate judge, verifies once before done, and reviews with code-review plus the stack reviewers of enabled plugins, with a separate judge agent deciding which findings are valid and findings left as is collected as review principles. Sub-sessions opened from a Fable session run on the latest model one step lower at high effort. Fix-and-recheck loops stop and hand over after three failed fixes of the same criterion, and in end the work session may hand mechanical review fixes to a Sonnet agent. A Stop hook re-runs the base branch's verify command when an item is marked done (and says so if the branch changed it), also after another Stop hook such as /goal has blocked. Web and server ports are split per item. Mechanical steps run as tested scripts: picking a free item port, and in end running the branch's new tests against the base branch's source to flag tests that do not prove the fix. A review finding fixed before or seen in several places can also become a new item that blocks it with a lint rule, test or type.

plugins.name: frontend
plugins.description: Frontend checks for /task start and /task end (Svelte and React references that hand general rules to the official Svelte, Vercel React and React Router skills and the Next.js bundled docs, scripts that start the dev server on the item port and check added lines for debug code and dependency changes for the lockfile), the ui-design skill (DESIGN.md and Claude Code design canvas mockups, brought in by the start check when an item adds or redesigns a screen or needs DESIGN.md), the frontend-reviewer and design-reviewer agents for review, and the frontend-evaluator agent that verifies acceptance criteria in the browser.

plugins.name: server
plugins.description: Backend and Supabase checks for /task start and /task end (Node.js servers and Supabase: migrations, RLS, keys; config keys, committed value files and keys checked by a script) and the api-reviewer and supabase-reviewer agents.
